clues: This is a coastal city in eastern China. It looks out to the East China Sea.
Big ocean storms strike this coast again and again. Its spot on the shore leaves it open to fierce typhoons.
In 2004, Typhoon Rananim slammed into one of its shore towns. It was the sixth strongest storm in China on record.
Crews here break down piles of old gadgets for scrap. The work has left the soil around town stained.
A power station named Jiangxia stands here by the shore. It makes power from the push and pull of the tides.
